verdict.rationale: Gusto's official remote MCP server (mcp.api.gusto.com) uses an OAuth2 connection that lets the user choose which categories of data the connected LLM can access, described as scoped, least-privilege access per connection. This is supplemented by distinct system-level access tokens in the API auth docs and separate sandbox/production credential slots in the agent-friendly CLI. missing for 10: a detailed list of scopes or permission granularity (e.g., read vs. write), credential revocation/expiry controls, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the scoping behavior.
